text: The Needleman-Wunsch algorithm is designed to solve which alignment problem?
choices: Global end-to-end alignment of two full sequences
Local alignment restricted to the best-scoring subregion
Multiple sequence alignment across a gene family
explanation: Needleman-Wunsch is the classic dynamic-programming algorithm for global alignment, aligning two sequences end-to-end with gap penalties at both edges. Local alignment restricted to a subregion is Smith-Waterman, multiple sequence alignment is a distinct problem solved by tools like MUSCLE/MAFFT, and seed-and-extend heuristics describe BLAST rather than an exact DP method.
